data.name: Gaunts Gambit | Multiplayer FPS
data.detailed_description:
DESCRIPTION:

Gaunts Gambit is a multiplayer first person shooter game. Set in an abandoned school left empty because of a rampant virus, former students sneak back in fighting over control of the grounds and buildings.

GAMEMODES:

  • 2v2 TeamMatch

  • Zombies

  • FFA

2V2 TEAMMATCH:

Players are divided into two teams of two, where they battle for their team in a singular building. The team with the most kills wins the match!

ZOMBIES:

Players face waves of zombies, barricading entrances to slow them down. Survive as long as possible against the increasing difficulty!

FFA:

Players compete solo in a battle for the highest kill count before the timer runs out.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 6th Gen Intel Core i5-6600K
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1660
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Additional Notes: Recommended to use DLSS Balanced or Ultra Performance.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game features mild blood effects and large blood stains when players are eliminated. There is no gore; the blood effects are not fully realistic.

The visual style is not hyper-realistic. Mature content is presented in a comical, and unserious manner.

The game contains frequent strong language, appearing in 60% of voice lines.

The main map is set in an abandoned school building that has been unused for years. This setting has no correlation to real-life tragedies. We do not endorse such disgraceful acts in any way. Neither the game nor we have any association with such events.
